programme.title: South Park: En elefant älskar med en gris

programme.title: South Park: Strejk

programme.title: South Park: Rektor PK:s rättvisa

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: En tröstande gest blir missförstådd och blossar istället upp till en gigantisk konflikt. Glädjande nog är en latino-lover på väg för att charma tjejerna, men glädjen riskerar att bli kortvarig.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Paradise Hotel slår återigen upp portarna, och den här säsongen checkar 14 gäster in – redan första dagen. Clean girls ställs mot Mean girls och frågan är – vad föredrar egentligen killarna?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Fyra Mean girls har checkat in och minst sagt rört om i grytan. Kampen om killarna är stenhård och stämningen förvärras ytterligare när en tjej ska röstas ut – redan innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Vilka tvingas checka ut från Paradise Hotel redan första veckan och vilka får fortsätta spela spelet i jakten på en halv miljon kronor? Det har blivit dags för säsongens första parceremoni!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Valet på parceremonin skapar splittring på hotellet. Det har blivit dags för superhjältarna att ta plats i paradiset, men mörka krafter hotar, och oron blir stor när tjejerna mystiskt försvinner.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Superskurken gör allt för att vara neutral trots att motiven kraftigt ifrågasätts. Heta känslor, kraftig paranoia och svidande lärdomar är ledorden för kvällens superhjältefest.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: En PH-Legend checkar in i kampen mot superskurkens planer – men vem spelar på vilken sida egentligen? Säsongens första pandoras ask väntar och skurkaktiga planer hotar att förstöra stämningen totalt!

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2308
programme.desc: Personliga assistenten Joacim, 24, som bor i Eskilstuna med sin pojkvän Fred, lever i ett ekonomiskt kaos. Trots enorma skulder slösar han stora summor pengar framför allt på sitt utseende.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 3104
programme.desc: 22-åriga Moa satte sig själv i en riktigt dålig ekonomisk sits när hon hamnade i en period där fest och resor gick före att gå till jobbet. Magnus åker nu till Gotland för att få rätsida på situationen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2905
programme.desc: Sandra är uppvuxen i fosterhem och har aldrig lärt sig hur en vuxen persons ekonomi fungerar. Hon har däremot levt som att hon haft en stadig inkomst hela livet trots att så inte varit fallet...

programme.title: Lyxfällan
programme.desc: Eleonor har länge burit på en hemlighet – skulder hos Kronofogden som avslöjades när Ulfs bil blev utmätt under en poliskontroll. Nu är tilliten mellan dem krossad och relationen på bristningsgränsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2410
programme.desc: Sanne och Christoffer från Ängelholm lever i ett ekonomiskt kaos. Det separerade paret – som fortfarande bor tillsammans – går totalt back 81 000 kr i månaden och har närmre en miljon kronor i skulder.

programme.title: Lyxfällan
programme.desc: Sara är skuldsatt efter en destruktiv relation där hon försörjde sitt ex. Trots stöd från sin sambo och mamma Eva, som har fått en allvarlig diagnos, kämpar Sara med ekonomin och verklighetsflykten.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 119
programme.desc: Lina har fått nog av alla predikningar över hur en mamma ska vara och inte vara. Ett av hennes största intressen är skönhet och ofta får hon höra hur hon prioriterar fel.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 120
programme.desc: I det sista avsnittet av Unga Mammor är det dags att kicka igång 2017 lämna 2016 bakom oss. Våra mammor ser tillbaka på höjdpunkterna från det gångna året och sätter upp mål för det nya.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 301
programme.desc: Unga mammor är tillbaka med en tredje säsong! Ny mamma är Fayme Elmén, 21 år, som bor i Segersäng tillsammans med sin man Moltas och de tre barnen Colin, Leo och Mila.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Milan och morfar tar tåget till flygplatsen för att ta emot Julia efter sin Rysslandsresa. Fayme och barnen firar att pappa Moltas fyller 24 år, men firandet tvingas avbrytas för en resa till sjukhuset.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Hemma hos Fayme är det kaos i vanlig ordning när familjen ska göra sig iordning för familjefotografering. Julia och Milan åker hem till Julias mamma för att tvätta. Linn och Tindra vaknar till ett förskräckligt buller

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 304

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 305

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 306

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: Linn vill spruta bröstmjölk på alla som kommenterar negativt kring amning på öppen plats och för första gången åker hon in till stan med Tindra. Julia och Milan besöker Julias syster Maja.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 308
programme.desc: Julia berättar om hur hon tacklar elaka kommentarer på sociala medier. Hon får väldigt många fina kommentarer men det finns även de som tycker att hon lever på Milans handikapp.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 309

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1206

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1303

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1103

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 105

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 201

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wives Battle Mistresses
programme.desc: Today, Vicki will face her husband Jason and his lover with an ultimatum and Anna admits she’s trying to steal Misty’s husband – again!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: We Live In A Car
programme.desc: Our guests say they're ready to come clean. Yolando regrets sleeping with her best friend’s boyfriend and Cameron has been hiding a secret from his roommates.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: High Class Call Girls
programme.desc: Bambi gives us a rare, honest look into her ultra-exclusive lifestyle in LA. Tiffany confronts C.T. over a rotten business deal.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell With My Feuding Family
programme.desc: There’s no worse time to be fighting with your family than during the holidays. Our old friends Donna and her cheating husband Richard join us for a holiday feast!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheating Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Chris and Steve confess to cheating on their girlfriends and Michelle wants to tell her boyfriend she has a mistress. The tension is high on today's Jerry Springer Show!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: My Pimp Runs My Family
programme.desc: Tracy and Allen have been living in a car. Her two older sisters are here to convince her to temporarily live with them and go back to school until he can provide for them.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Girl Next Door

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder in a Bottle
programme.desc: Eric Houston is found stabbed to death in a seedy motel, but the ensuing investigation is stymied by a long list of suspects. Lt. Joe Kenda deploys a groundbreaking new technology to catch the killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Gut Instinct
programme.desc: When a soon-to-be grandmother doesn’t come home from work and the investigation unfolds, Lt. Joe Kenda realizes they could be dealing with a fledgling serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: To The Death
programme.desc: When two young men are found shot in an apartment hallway, Kenda must rely on his inner lie detector to figure out which victim was no victim at all.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: We Kill the Ones We Love
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves Van Terry dead; to crack the case, Lt. Joe Kenda must put his faith… in a burglar.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Who Killed Jane?

programme.title: 48 Hours: Fatal Mistake
programme.desc: Explores the issue of young women who conceive children and hide the pregnancy. They secretly give birth and then abandon the baby, some claiming that their babies were born dead.

programme.title: 48 Hours: My Father's Killer

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Killer Next Door
programme.desc: Donald Miller, was sentenced to 30 to 50 years for rape and attempted murder but was suspected in four other murders. In an unusual plea bargain, Miller agreed to work with police trying to recover his memories of other murders.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Glass Cage

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Live Bait

programme.title: MacGyver: Strictly Business

programme.title: MacGyver: Trail of Tears

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 301
programme.desc: Astrid och Steffen ska köpa sitt första hus, men de kan inte kompromissa med sina önskemål. De träffar programmets experter som köper ett hus för deras räkning.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Louise och Michael har vuxit ut ur sin lilla lägenhet i Århus och behöver mer utrymme. Paret gör en kompromiss och Louise möter sin största mardröm i huset som experterna köper åt dem.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Charlotte och Mikkel bor i en så liten lägenhet att duschen måste tömmas på saker varje gång de ska använda den. Men nu vill de flytta från staden med deras son.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Pernille och Nicklas från Odense lever så litet att om de behöver lite privatliv har de bara toaletten att gå till. Nicklas drömmer om att ha ett kök med två ugnar så att han kan laga mer mat.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Wendy och Jesper från Kalundborg bor redan bra, i en lägenhet som har en otrolig utsikt. Men en kommande familjeökning innebär att de måste hitta något större.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Jonas och Louise blir chockade när de ser vilka hus de har råd med. Mads Mikkelsen och Tobias Edlev Nielsen arbetar övertid för att försöka uppfylla parets önskemål.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Snow

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Beggar's Comet
programme.desc: Not wanting to put the Tunnel World in further danger, Vincent decides to leave the tunnels and with the death of Snow, Gabriel plots for Vincent's demise.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Time to Heal
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the boat explosion that most likely killed Elliot, Diana is shocked when she encounters a wounded Vincent who collapses on Catherine's grave.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Chimes at Midnight

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1301

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 304

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker SV: Avsnitt 103

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 704

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag såg honom först

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
